modules.text:
How to Edit Jack Values

1. Press on the knob and move up and down to change the value.
2. Drag the mouse to the LEFT then drag UP and DOWN for COARSE control.
3. Drag the mouse to the RIGHT then drag UP and DOWN for FINE control.

The knob gives you a nice visual way to edit values. You can also edit jacks directly. The "+" modules adds its two inputs, A and B, together.

1. Click on the "B" jack and drag up and down. Notice that it shows the numeric value. 
2. You can move left/right for coarse or fine control, just like with the knob.
3. Make B a number around 80.
4. Move the knob and notice that the values in the show module are offset by the B value.
